proposal.title: Restructure external product impacts — Heath H17 disk subsystem
proposal.reason: Consolidate descriptive content and move assessed product/standard effects into typed impact sections. Preserve historical interfaces, fictional-world boundaries and qualification limits. Evidence: data_storytelling/review_evidence/external-impact-revision/assessment.json.

before.name: Heath H17 disk subsystem
before.description: Heath H17 disk subsystem is a storage peripheral for Heath H8 / H89 configurations.

specification.description: Hard-sectored 5¼-inch floppy storage with Heath-specific controller and software. The intended host environment is {host}. Interfaces, cabling and software must match that configuration.
Assessment at 1979-12-31. The accessory is tied to the named third-party platform. No qualified Logix attachment or same-host Logix substitute is established, so no direct product impact is assigned.
Assessment at 1979-12-31. The native host interface does not implement a core Logix/AION standard. A possible future bridge is not an existing implementation or adoption effect.
